notes.title: Update announcement for version 0.9.1
notes.notes:
1 Added game help menu
2 Increased weapon drop chance, normal also has a chance to drop
3 Greatly increases the explosion damage of cursed skills
4 Increases the damage of Void Sword Intent
5 Too Void Sword Intent, the Ice Trick of Returning to the Sky is changed to launch according to the direction of the character
6 Fixed the display hierarchy issue of some maps
7 Knockback effect increased
8 Slow effect increased
9 Fixed a bug where weapon achievements were not activated
10 Changed the invincibility duration to 2 seconds after the arrival of the epee
11 Gain 2 seconds of invincibility after the first blunt attack, and reduce the massive damage to the boss by 30%
12 Fixed an issue where weapon dashes could be pulled back in the mob pile

notes.title: Update 0.8.9
notes.notes:
1, increased the availability of weapon systems and related materials
2. Adjust the damage of the weapon every time it is upgraded
3. Blue weapons have a certain chance to activate side skills
4. The heavy sword attack has an explosive effect
5. Increase the damage and hit rate of the second stage of blunt weapon attacks

notes.title: Version 0.7.6 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1 Demon Island map is now live, this map has no statues or monoliths, only relics.
2 Sunset Canyon birth point changed to the left end, adding one full map statue/monolith refresh. (Misty Swamp and Sunset Canyon have no relics, only statues and monoliths, but will refresh at intermediate times)
2 Increase character initial movement speed
3 Adjusted the balance of some skills, now there are up to three options for skill breakthrough.
4 Battle interface shows the boss refresh countdown
5 Fix some text description problems

Tip: This update networking function has not been tested, use with caution!

notes.title: Version 0.61beta update
notes.notes:
Updated content
Fixed bugs in skills with spike characteristics and added feedback sound effects.
Adjusted the trigger probability of spike skills.
Adjusted the balance of several skills.
Adjusted the number of points gained from character advancement 10/20/30. Increased initial movement speed by 10%.
Increased the difficulty of each challenge by one notch, and now you need to pay attention to the control characteristics of the skills in the highest difficulty, or else it will be difficult to pass the level.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
